trance.direction: Mix new releases and older progressive, melodic and uplifting trance; include Danish productions where suitable.
trance.requirement: Do not use an all-classics selection; verify release date and nationality before describing a track as new or Danish.

retro.direction: Late 1970s, all of the 1980s and early 1990s; Danish and international; standard original/single/album versions.

eurodance.direction: 1990–2009 dance hits: bubblegum pop, eurodance, hard dance, hands up, UK Clubland style and Scandinavian/Danish internet-radio atmosphere.
eurodance.qualification: References express user taste; do not claim documented station airplay without sources.

workflow: Music selection and fixed Spotify playlists first; scripts and public weekly notes must follow the final verified order.
